items.excerpt: Newly published USPTO patent filings show Adobe working on a method for generating 3D worlds from text prompts, hinting at where Firefly could expand beyond image and video generation.

PHLEARN's Aaron Nace shows Photoshop's Remove tool doesn't consume generative credits even with Generative AI and cloud processing on, plus other overlooked features that preserve a designer's monthly AI credit budget.

CG Channel's weekly roundup leads with Alpha Gen, an experimental alpha-matte generation component of Lightricks' VFX-focused AI world model LTX-2.5 that removes video backgrounds, alongside updates to Caddis, RailClone and others.
Quadify is a family of Blender add-ons that converts triangle-soup meshes from AI 3D generators, scans and CAD imports into clean, animation-ready quad topology without manual retopology.
Skylum is discontinuing its AI portrait editor Aperty to focus on Luminar, leaving lifetime license holders without the five years of updates they were promised.
A practitioner workflow for fixing garbled text in AI-generated images by editing it in place rather than burning more generations.

BIMlogiq has expanded Argus, a multi-agent AI platform inside Revit, adding a Family Creation Agent that builds fully parametric Revit families from scratch, a Bathroom Agent for ADA-compliant layouts, and an MEP Systems Agent.

OpenSpace has added AI agents to its Visual Intelligence reality-capture platform that can see, understand and act on job-site data, moving from recording construction to helping teams decide in real time.

RoboParty unveiled RP1, pitched as the first high-performance full-stack open-source bipedal humanoid, with up to 160 N·m joint torque and support for embodied AI development by researchers and builders.
CMU Safe AI lab director Ding Zhao co-founded Safeworld, which builds digital humans to test and underwrite the safety of robots driven by generative AI models before they are deployed among people.
AI is not making us less intelligent but reducing the intelligence we practise; the essay examines skill atrophy and cognitive offloading when designers outsource judgement and struggle to AI.
Designers agree taste is the last human advantage in the age of AI, yet the essay argues our tools and de-risking habits now make taste almost impossible to develop.
A designer on working with several AI agents in parallel tabs, producing more than ever while losing the ability to see any project whole.
A walkthrough of Claude Code mods for designers: what they are and a practical workflow for building custom mods tailored to your own design use cases.
A writer used Claude to vibe-code a paid Mac app and pass Apple's App Store review in 11 days without writing a line of code, documenting the idea-to-product journey.
Pope Leo XIV denounced AI-generated art, saying algorithms lack the spark of humanity, adding a high-profile voice to the creative-community debate over generative imagery.
Amsterdam creative production company Ambassadors has opened Mosa, its in-house visual AI workflow platform, to everyone.
Apple issued a notice warning creators against granting AI agents Full Disk Access on macOS and promised new controls to address the critical risks.
